documentation_excerpts.text: Temporal is a durable execution platform that enables developers to build scalable applications without sacrificing productivity or reliability. The Temporal server executes units of application logic called Workflows in a resilient manner that automatically handles intermittent failures, and retries failed operations.
Temporal is a mature technology that originated as a fork of Uber's Cadence. It is developed by [Temporal Technologies](https://temporal.io/), a startup by the creators of Cadence.
